protocol: Retrospective after single-query results are known, never an independent test. Use only words that already occurred in the corresponding locked English query. Split into one subject or factual aspect per phrase. Same maximum 3 or 6 distinct reviewed source blocks in all conditions. Round-robin first direct result per search, then second, then third; remove duplicates. If the budget permits, use actual rendered context blocks, nearest first, earlier block on a tie, round-robin across direct hits. Stop on exhaustion. Count query submissions separately from distinct blocks; no participants or measured reading time. Keep all six claims even when no source exists.
